title: Replace /wishes admin page with a simple refreshable wishes list (no password, no navigation link)

requirements.text: Update the backend canister in `backend/main.mo` so it compiles and exposes a stable, upgrade-safe wishes store with the public methods `submitWish(text : Text) : async ()` and `getAllWishes() : async [Text]` returning all wishes in submission order.

quotes:
I need a hidden admin page to view the wishes people have submitted.

Please create a new page at the route /wishes that does the following:

Calls the backend function getAllWishes().

Displays the list of messages in a simple table or list format.

Add a 'Refresh' button to reload the list.

(Optional) Add a simple password protection so only I can see it.
Functionality: Ensure the page fetches data using the backend getAllWishes() function and displays the wishes in a clean list with timestamps (if available) or just the text.

acceptanceCriteria: Candid interface includes `submitWish: (text: text) -> ()` and `getAllWishes: () -> (vec text) query`.
Wishes submitted via `submitWish` are persisted across canister upgrades (stable storage) and returned by `getAllWishes()` in the same order they were submitted.

requirements.text: Replace the `/wishes` page UI in `frontend/src/pages/WishesPage.tsx` with a minimal admin view that calls `getAllWishes()` and displays wishes in a clean table or list, with a visible "Refresh" button that reloads the list on demand.

quotes:
Please create a new page at the route /wishes that does the following:

Calls the backend function getAllWishes().

Displays the list of messages in a simple table or list format.

Add a 'Refresh' button to reload the list.
Functionality: Ensure the page fetches data using the backend getAllWishes() function and displays the wishes in a clean list with timestamps (if available) or just the text.

acceptanceCriteria: Visiting `/wishes` fetches wishes using the existing backend actor and `getAllWishes()` (no localStorage-based data source).
A "Refresh" button is present and triggers a refetch so new wishes appear without a full page reload.
The page renders a clean list/table of wish text; if timestamps are not available from the backend, only the text is shown.
The page includes basic loading, error, and empty states.

requirements.text: Ensure the `/wishes` admin page remains hidden from the main gift page UI (no navigation link or menu item added) and remains accessible only by directly visiting `/wishes` in the browser.
acceptanceCriteria: No new link/button is added on the main `/` gift experience that points to `/wishes`.
Direct navigation to `/wishes` continues to render the wishes admin page.

requirements.text: Regenerate backend Candid/declarations after updating `backend/main.mo` so the frontend actor typing/bindings remain consistent with the updated canister interface.
acceptanceCriteria: Frontend builds with up-to-date generated declarations reflecting the backend canister interface.
`useGetAllWishes()` and `useSubmitWish()` continue to typecheck and run against the regenerated declarations.

constraints: Do not add any password protection for `/wishes`.
Do not add any navigation elements on the main gift page to reach `/wishes`; the route should be reachable only by typing `/wishes` manually.
Respect the existing single-actor backend architecture (all Motoko logic remains in `backend/main.mo`; only use `backend/migration.mo` if an actual state migration is required).
Do not edit frontend files under the immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (compose existing UI components instead).
Use English for any user-facing text added/changed as part of this build request.
nonGoals: Do not reveal or attempt to retrieve backend canister IDs or deployment metadata in the UI.
Do not implement authentication/Internet Identity gating for the `/wishes` page.
Do not add real-time updates (polling/websockets); refresh is manual via the button.
